source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved SATA Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without losing controller, port, disk, RAID, encryption, boot or storage availability.
original_method: Change SATA fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while collecting firmware, controller/port/disk, boot, storage-health and log evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate SATA Configuration, perform both save/reboot/default phases and inspect firmware values. Automated read-only disk/controller inventory is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named SATA fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
AHCI/RAID, encryption, mount and data dependencies
Console/operator, backups, recovery material, stable power and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or switch AHCI/RAID/controller mode without compatible OS and recovery planning.
Do not format, write, repartition, rebuild arrays or modify encryption as an implicit check.
Protect OS, mounted, in-use and protected disks from unauthorized writes.
Stop on missing disk/array, degraded RAID, boot failure, data-path error or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only controller/port/disk/serial, RAID/encryption, mount, boot, health and BMC evidence.
Compare operator BIOS captures and immutable device identities against the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, change arrays/controllers, write storage or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve SATA fields/defaults, protected-device dependencies, recovery and final mode.
Evaluate firmware and read-only storage evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; storage inventory must remain read-only and cannot become controller-mode, RAID or disk mutation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual BIOS changes and add approved read-only controller, disk-serial, RAID/encryption, mount and boot inventory; do not substitute OS storage configuration tools.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source text but is bounded out of execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved BIOS field to exact controller mode, port, disk serial, boot/data role and expected visibility; capture firmware and read-only storage state at baseline, persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/SATA controller topology, drives and installed OS/storage stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, controller/disk firmware, OS/kernel and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SATA Configuration specification and project RAID/encryption/boot recovery definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds device identity and non-destructive mode-change safety while retaining both firmware transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; no write, array rebuild, encryption or performance claim is implied.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/default/mode matrix, port-device roles and recovery material.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS device names may reorder and controller-mode changes may make the OS unbootable before any readback is possible.

project_override_considerations: The project may select safe SATA fields/ports and omit unsafe mode changes. Completion applies only to the approved matrix and must not claim write-path or all-controller coverage.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, exact controller/port/disk/boot/dependency baseline and recovery
First save/reboot persistence plus read-only controller/disk/RAID evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and storage/boot health
Final mode/configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing fields and storage dependencies are readiness inputs rather than conflicts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SATA setting lifecycle is clear. Exact values, compatibility and recovery gate execution but do not permanently block the common library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual boundary and adds controller-mode/device safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains read-only storage evidence and recovery controls but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY and explicitly protects mounted, boot and encrypted storage.

review_improvement: Prevents a default-setting test from silently switching controller mode or damaging arrays/data and prevents automated inventory from being mistaken for firmware automation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive configuration operations and observations are manual BIOS actions, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Read-only storage evidence cannot automate the core acceptance.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat SATA mode/field changes, reboot or default load after missing disks, degraded arrays, boot loss or ambiguous evidence; preserve the first state and obtain engineer disposition.
